lessons.source_ref: Ministry Primary 1 T1 student book, Unit 4 Lesson 1, pdf p.66-69
lessons.goal_ar: النهارده هنتعلم أسماء أجزاء الجسم ونقول كام واحد عندنا من كل حاجة.

steps.body_ar: head = رأس. eye = عين. ear = ودن. nose = أنف. mouth = بُق. tongue = لسان. arms = دراعين. hand = إيد. legs = رجلين. foot = قدم (وfeet أكتر من قدم). toes = صوابع الرجل.
steps.body_en: Learn these body words: head, eye, ear, nose, mouth, tongue, arms, hand, legs, foot, feet and toes. Foot means one; feet means more than one.

steps.body_ar: head يعني رأس.
steps.body_en: Learn the word head.

steps.body_ar: eye يعني عين، وeyes يعني عينين. عندنا 2 eyes.
steps.body_en: Eye means one eye. Eyes means more than one. We have 2 eyes.

steps.body_ar: ear يعني ودن، وears يعني ودنين. بص على الدايرتين الحمرا.
steps.body_en: Ear means one ear. Ears means more than one. Look at the two red circles.

steps.body_ar: nose يعني أنف. عندنا 1 nose.
steps.body_en: We have 1 nose.

steps.body_ar: mouth يعني بُق. عندنا 1 mouth.
steps.body_en: We have 1 mouth.

steps.body_ar: arms يعني دراعين. بص على الصورة، الولد رافع دراعاته.
steps.body_en: Learn the word arms. Look at the picture: the boy is raising his arms.

steps.body_ar: hands يعني إيدين. بص على الصورة.
steps.body_en: Learn the word hands. Look at the picture.

steps.body_ar: legs يعني رجلين. بص على الصورة.
steps.body_en: Learn the word legs. Look at the picture.

steps.body_ar: feet يعني قدمين. القدم الواحدة foot.
steps.body_en: Feet means more than one foot. One is a foot.

steps.body_ar: tongue يعني لسان. toes يعني صوابع الرجل. على القدم الواحدة فيه 5 toes، يعني I have 5 toes on one foot. والقدمين 2 feet.
en: I have 5 toes on one foot.
steps.body_en: Learn the words tongue and toes. There are 5 toes on one foot: I have 5 toes on one foot. We have 2 feet.

steps.body_ar: نقول كام عندنا كده: I have 2 eyes. I have 1 nose. I have 2 legs. لما العدد 2 نزوّد s.
steps.body_en: Say how many you have like this: I have 2 eyes. I have 1 nose. I have 2 legs. Add s when the number is 2.

steps.body_ar: اختار العدد الصح.
steps.body_en: Choose the correct number.

steps.body_ar: رتّب الكلمات عشان تعمل جملة.
steps.body_en: Put the words in order to make a sentence.

steps.body_ar: كمّل المحادثة بنفسك.
steps.body_en: Complete the conversation yourself.

steps.body_ar: head، eyes، ears، nose، mouth، tongue، arms، hands، legs، feet، toes. I have 2 eyes. I have 1 mouth.
steps.body_en: Head, eyes, ears, nose, mouth, tongue, arms, hands, legs, feet and toes. I have 2 eyes. I have 1 mouth.

lessons.goal_en: Today we will learn the names of body parts and say how many of each we have.

lessons.source_ref: Ministry Primary 1 T1 student book, Unit 4 Lesson 2, pdf p.70-74
lessons.goal_ar: النهارده هنعرف حرفين: R وE، صوتهم وكلمات بتبدأ بيهم.

steps.body_ar: الحرف ليه اسم وصوت. اقرأ كلمات الدرس وشوف الحرف في أولها. الشرح هنا مكتوب، والنطق الصوتي هيتضاف بعد مراجعته.
steps.body_en: A letter has a name and a sound. Read the lesson words and find the letter at the beginning. This explanation is written; pronunciation audio will be added after review.

steps.body_ar: rabbit يعني أرنب. بتبدأ بحرف r.
steps.body_en: Learn the word rabbit. It begins with r.

steps.body_ar: ring يعني خاتم. بتبدأ بحرف r.
steps.body_en: Learn the word ring. It begins with r.

steps.body_ar: red يعني أحمر. بتبدأ بحرف r.
steps.body_en: Learn the color red. It begins with r.

steps.body_ar: robot يعني روبوت. rocket يعني صاروخ. بيبدأوا بحرف r.
steps.body_en: Learn the words robot and rocket. They begin with r.

steps.body_ar: الحرف الكبير R والصغير r. اتتبّعهم واكتبهم في كتابك واتبع الأسهم.
steps.body_en: The capital letter is R and the small letter is r. Trace and write them in your book. Follow the arrows.

steps.body_ar: اختار الحرف اللي بتبدأ بيه الكلمة.
steps.body_en: Choose the letter that the word begins with.

steps.body_ar: رتّب الحروف وكوّن الكلمة.
steps.body_en: Put the letters in order to make the word.

steps.body_ar: الحرف ليه اسم وصوت. اقرأ كلمات الدرس وشوف الحرف في أولها. الشرح هنا مكتوب، والنطق الصوتي هيتضاف بعد مراجعته.
steps.body_en: A letter has a name and a sound. Read the lesson words and find the letter at the beginning. This explanation is written; pronunciation audio will be added after review.

steps.body_ar: egg يعني بيضة. بتبدأ بحرف e.
steps.body_en: Learn the word egg. It begins with e.

steps.body_ar: elephant يعني فيل. بتبدأ بحرف e.
steps.body_en: Learn the word elephant. It begins with e.

steps.body_ar: eggplant يعني باذنجان. elbow يعني كوع. enter يعني ادخل. كلهم بيبدأوا بحرف e.
steps.body_en: Learn the words eggplant, elbow and enter. Enter means to go in. They all begin with e.

steps.body_ar: الحرف الكبير E والصغير e. اتتبّعهم واكتبهم واتبع الأسهم.
steps.body_en: The capital letter is E and the small letter is e. Trace and write them in your book. Follow the arrows.

steps.body_ar: رتّب الحروف وكوّن الكلمة.
steps.body_en: Put the letters in order to make the word.

steps.body_ar: r: red، ring، rabbit، robot، rocket. e: egg، elephant، eggplant، elbow، enter.
steps.body_en: r: red, ring, rabbit, robot, rocket. e: egg, elephant, eggplant, elbow, enter.

lessons.goal_en: Today we will learn two letters, R and E, their sounds and words that begin with them.

lessons.source_ref: Ministry Primary 1 T1 student book, Unit 4 Lesson 3, pdf p.75-78
lessons.goal_ar: النهارده هنتعلم الحواس الخمسة وبنستخدم كل حاسة بإيه.

steps.body_ar: Aly وOmar بيتكلموا عن الحواس. الجمل المهمة:
en: Omar: I can see the teacher and the desk.
Aly: I can smell it with my nose.
Omar: I can hear the teacher with my ears.
Aly: I can touch the desk with my hands.
Omar: I can taste it with my tongue!
steps.body_en: Aly and Omar are talking about the senses. Read the key sentences.

steps.body_ar: see = يشوف. hear = يسمع. smell = يشم. taste = يدوق. touch = يلمس. والحواس خمسة.
steps.body_en: Learn the words see, hear, smell, taste and touch. There are five senses.

steps.body_ar: I can see with my eyes. بنشوف بالعين.
en: I can see with my eyes.
steps.body_en: I can see with my eyes. We use our eyes to see.

steps.body_ar: I can hear with my ears. بنسمع بالودن. بص على الدايرتين الحمرا في الصورة، دي الودنين.
en: I can hear with my ears.
steps.body_en: I can hear with my ears. We use our ears to hear. Look at the two red circles in the picture: those are the ears.

steps.body_ar: I can smell with my nose. بنشم بالأنف.
en: I can smell with my nose.
steps.body_en: I can smell with my nose. We use our nose to smell.

steps.body_ar: I can taste with my tongue. بنداق باللسان.
en: I can taste with my tongue.
steps.body_en: I can taste with my tongue. We use our tongue to taste.

steps.body_ar: I can touch with my hands. بنلمس بالإيدين.
en: I can touch with my hands.
steps.body_en: I can touch with my hands. We use our hands to touch.

steps.body_ar: اختار الكلمة الصح.
steps.body_en: Choose the correct word.

steps.body_ar: رتّب الكلمات عشان تعمل جملة.
steps.body_en: Put the words in order to make a sentence.

steps.body_ar: كمّل المحادثة بنفسك.
steps.body_en: Complete the conversation yourself.

steps.body_ar: see بالعين، hear بالودن، smell بالأنف، taste باللسان، touch بالإيد.
steps.body_en: See with your eyes, hear with your ears, smell with your nose, taste with your tongue and touch with your hands.

lessons.goal_en: Today we will learn the five senses and the body parts we use for each sense.

lessons.source_ref: Ministry Primary 1 T1 student book, Unit 4 Lesson 4, pdf p.79-83

steps.body_ar: cat يعني قطة. بتبدأ بحرف c.
steps.body_en: Learn the word cat. It begins with c.

steps.body_ar: cake يعني كيكة. بتبدأ بحرف c.
steps.body_en: Learn the word cake. It begins with c.

steps.body_ar: cup يعني كوباية. بتبدأ بحرف c.
steps.body_en: Learn the word cup. It begins with c.

steps.body_ar: car يعني عربية. carrot يعني جزرة. بيبدأوا بحرف c.
steps.body_en: Learn the words car and carrot. They begin with c.

steps.body_ar: الحرف الكبير C والصغير c. اتتبّعهم واكتبهم واتبع الأسهم.
steps.body_en: The capital letter is C and the small letter is c. Trace and write them in your book. Follow the arrows.

steps.body_ar: رتّب الحروف وكوّن الكلمة.

steps.body_ar: الحرف ليه اسم وصوت. اقرأ كلمات الدرس وشوف الحرف في أولها. الشرح هنا مكتوب، والنطق الصوتي هيتضاف بعد مراجعته.
steps.body_en: A letter has a name and a sound. Read the lesson words and find the letter at the beginning. This explanation is written; pronunciation audio will be added after review.

steps.body_ar: key يعني مفتاح. بتبدأ بحرف k.
steps.body_en: Learn the word key. It begins with k.

steps.body_ar: kite يعني طيارة ورق. بتبدأ بحرف k.
steps.body_en: Learn the word kite. It begins with k.

steps.body_ar: king يعني ملك. kangaroo يعني كانجارو. kitchen يعني مطبخ. بيبدأوا بحرف k.
steps.body_en: Learn the words king, kangaroo and kitchen. They begin with k.

steps.body_ar: الحرف الكبير K والصغير k. اتتبّعهم واكتبهم واتبع الأسهم.
steps.body_en: The capital letter is K and the small letter is k. Trace and write them in your book. Follow the arrows.

steps.body_ar: رتّب الحروف وكوّن الكلمة.
steps.body_en: Put the letters in order to make the word.

steps.body_ar: c: cat، cake، cup، car، carrot. k: key، kite، king، kangaroo، kitchen.
steps.body_en: c: cat, cake, cup, car, carrot. k: key, kite, king, kangaroo, kitchen.

lessons.goal_en: Today we will learn two letters, C and K, and notice that they have the same sound in these words.
